name: Claude Code Development Environment
description: Installs the Claude Code IDE extension (anthropic.claude-code) for VS Code and Cursor, and optionally the claude CLI. Persists ~/.claude (credentials, config, memory) across rebuilds and Codespaces via a Docker named volume, dedicated to this devcontainer. Also self-heals your devcontainer setup.

username.description: Username in the container that should receive the Claude credentials symlink. 'auto' detects vscode/node/codespace/uid-1000, in that order.

installCli.description: Also install the Claude Code CLI (claude command) via the official native installer.

remoteControl.description: Keep a Claude Code Remote Control server (claude remote-control) running in a background tmux session, so sessions can be started from claude.ai/code or the Claude mobile app. Implies installCli. Sends session transcripts to Anthropic while connected.

remoteControlName.description: Title of the server's first session and prefix of every session name in claude.ai/code (not the environment label, which Claude Code takes from the git repository name). Empty means: $CLAUDE_RC_NAME, then org-workspace's org, then the owner of the origin remote, then the workspace folder name.

remoteControlDir.description: Directory the server runs in (what its sessions start in). Empty means the workspace folder, the one you opened in VS Code.

remoteControlSpawn.description: How the server creates sessions: same-dir (all share the directory) or worktree (one git worktree per session; needs the directory to be a git repository).

remoteControlAutoTrust.description: Answer yes to Claude Code's 'Trust this folder?' question for the Remote Control folder, so the server starts with no manual step. Trusting applies that folder's project settings (hooks, MCP servers, permission rules) to the server's sessions: enable it only for code you trust. Off: you run `claude` once in the folder and accept it yourself.

remoteControlPermissionMode.description: Starting permission mode for the server's sessions (e.g. acceptEdits, plan). Empty means Claude Code's default.
